meta.title: Fleet Intelligence — Connectivity operations
meta.description: Real-time connectivity operations and executive dashboard for large IoT fleets: live telemetry, AI-diagnosed incidents, cost and ROI.

mode.label: Data source
mode.liveHint: Streaming from the live gateway (Kafka → SSE)
mode.demoHint: Deterministic in-browser stream mirroring the simulator's fault scenarios
mode.liveUnavailable: No live gateway configured for this deployment
mode.errorBody: The gateway could not be reached. The browser keeps retrying; you can switch to demo mode meanwhile.

common.noDataBody: The first frames usually arrive within a second or two.

overview.title: Executive overview
overview.subtitle: Fleet health, incident response and the business value delivered — computed from the stream and transparent assumptions.
overview.availabilityFoot: Connected share of reports, last 30 s
overview.mttrHint: Mean time from a confirmed incident to an approved remediation, a field dispatch or resolution. Month to date: the recorded baseline blended (by incident count) with the incidents remediated in this session.
overview.slaFoot: Target {target} · error budget used {budget} · last 15 min {recent}
overview.slaHint: Contract-style availability SLA: the month's mean connected share of device reports against the {target} target, time-weighted over the month so far. Error budget = the (1 − target) unavailability the month allows. A single cell outage moves the last-15-minutes figure a lot and the monthly figure a little.
overview.llmSpendFoot: Month to date · {month} projected · {share} of platform cost
overview.valueNarrative: So far this month the platform has helped avoid an estimated {avoided} truck rolls, worth {saved}, while running at {cost} month to date. At the current pace that is {projected} in avoided field visits against {monthCost} of platform cost — a {roi} return.
overview.valueRemote: In this session, {share} of AI diagnoses were remotely fixable (no truck roll).
overview.valueDisclaimer: Estimates from editable assumptions, not measured results. Validate with your own dispatch and SLA data.
overview.assumptionsBody: Every number on this page can be traced to these inputs and to the cost estimator's dated pricing table.
overview.aTruckRolls: Connectivity truck rolls per 1k devices / month (baseline)
overview.aAvoidable: Share avoidable with a remote root cause
overview.formula: Avoided = devices ÷ 1,000 × baseline rate × avoidable share × month elapsed

live.title: Live operations
live.subtitle: Per-second aggregates from the telemetry stream: throughput, radio quality and where the fleet is degrading.
live.throughputSub: Events per second with live anomaly signals
live.rsrpSub: Reference signal received power (dBm), connected reports
live.ratMixSub: Share of reports by radio access technology
live.anomalyTimelineSub: Fleet anomaly score with live signals and confirmed incidents
live.noAnomalies: All quiet — no anomalous scopes right now.
live.sampled: Distributions from {sampled} sampled reports this second (ingest downsampling).

map.title: Geo map
map.subtitle: Cell sites coloured by health. Click a site for metrics and related incidents.
map.noWebgl: Your browser cannot render the WebGL map. The cell table on the live page has the same data.
map.basemapNote: Basemap © OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap contributors. Site positions are deterministic stand-ins, not real tower locations.

incidents.title: Incidents & AI diagnosis
incidents.subtitle: Confirmed incidents with enrichment, a grounded LLM diagnosis in your language and a human-in-the-loop decision.
incidents.emptyBody: Incidents appear here as soon as the platform confirms an anomaly.
incidents.selectBody: Pick an incident from the feed to see its evidence, enrichment and AI diagnosis.
incidents.diagnosisPendingBody: Retrieving runbooks and calling the model. This usually takes a few seconds.
incidents.hitlBody: The platform never acts on its own: an operator approves the automated steps or dispatches field service.
incidents.confirmApprove: Approve the remediation plan for this incident? Automatable steps will be queued.
incidents.confirmDispatch: Dispatch a field technician? This creates a truck roll the AI marked as avoidable.
incidents.localOnly: Recorded locally in this browser (demo of the approval flow).

cost.title: Cost & ROI simulator
cost.subtitle: What does this cost at my scale? The same model as the platform's estimator, recomputed live in your browser.
cost.scale: Cost per device vs fleet size
cost.scaleSub: Fixed costs amortise with scale; the current scenario is highlighted
cost.recommendationsSub: Each lever re-runs the model with one change

rec.batch: Batch 10 readings per message at the edge
rec.cache: Cache diagnoses for repeated incident signatures (30% hit rate)
rec.tiering: Model tiering: small model first, escalate 20%
rec.logs: Trim log volume (300 B per invocation)

cost.pricing: Pricing table {version} ({region}). List-price assumptions, not quotes: no free tier, discounts or tax.
cost.parity: Parity-tested to the cent against the platform's Python estimator.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This view failed to render. The rest of the dashboard keeps working.
